newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On unit seen in HK$450-500 mln Hong Kong IPO.
newsitem.headline: Shui On unit seen in HK$450-500 mln Hong Kong IPO.

text.p: Shui On Contractors and Materials Ltd, a member of the Shui On Group, is expected to raise HK$450-500 million in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong later this month, market sources said on Tuesday.
Sources said the company is expected to issue 65 million shares at a price to earnings (P.E.) multiple of about 8.0 to 9.0 times.
Shui On Contractors is expected to hold a listing presentation later this week before kicking off its IPO later in January. Dealing in shares is expected to begin in early February, they said.
HSBC Investment is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said. No further details were available to the market.
Sources said proceeds are expected to be used to fund Shui On Contractors' investment in building materials businesses, including cement production, in China.
